candidate_ranking: No ranking. Show structured evidence per requirement only.
shortlist_export: User-selected only. The recruiter picks candidates manually; the system does not auto-shortlist.
retention_policy: Delete all data 30 days after the job opening is closed. No long-term storage in MVP.
single_job_mvp: Yes, one job opening at a time for the pilot.
default: Default to the most conservative option that keeps humans in control.
